title: Diagnosis report
description: The structured artifact produced when a piece of business logic cannot be verified. Verdict categories and evidence types are closed enums on purpose — the agent must choose, it may not free-associate. The same shape is produced by both the verify agent (a step it could not verify) and the healer agent (a locator it could not repair). src/diagnose.mjs is the executable form of these constraints.

id.description: Unique id for this report, traceable to a run.

stage.description: Which stage failed: verify (the step could not be verified) or heal (the locator could not be repaired).

step.description: The feature step that could not be verified, verbatim.

category.description: Whose fault it is. 'unverifiable' is a legitimate answer when the evidence does not support a frontend/backend attribution.

summary.description: One human sentence: what is wrong.

confidence.description: How sure the agent is of the attribution. 'low' is allowed and encouraged over a fake 'high'.

target.description: The request URL for network, the error location for console, the file path for snapshot.

captured.description: Path to a saved artifact (screenshot, trace).

observation.description: What the agent observed on the page.
